player_prompt.intro:
O dula Tower of Hanoi le {num_disks} disks.
O na le kwano ya go tsamaisa disks tse go tswa tower A go ya tower C.
Go tsamaisa disk, ngwala tower e o tswang go yona le tower e o yang go yona (e.g., '[A C]').
Gape o lemoga gore o ka tsamaisa disk e kgolo go tswa kwa nngwe, mme disk e kgolo ga e kgone go tsenngwa kwa yeo e kgolokgolo.
Ka kgwedi le kgwedi, o ngwalele pheto e le nngwe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ga o arabele go araba ka tsela e elego '[source] [target]'.
invalid_move.invalid_tower: O bontšhitše gore mothopo goba tora ya go lebiša e fošagetše.
invalid_move.empty_tower: O lekile go šuthiša disk ya tora yeo e se nago selo.
invalid_move.same_tower: O lekile go šutišetša disk toreng yona yeo.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: O lekile go bea disk e kgolo godimo ga diseke e nyenyane.

game_action.moved: O tsamaisitse disk {disk} go tswa {source} go ya {target}.

outcome.win: Ke a go lebogiša! O rarolotše phasele ya Tora ya Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: O beile ka tshwanelo {pct}% ya di-disc go Tora C.
